params.description: If present, wpArea is a form object name (Text); if omitted, wpArea is a 4D Write Pro object variable or field.

params.name: targetObj
params.description: Range, element (table/row/paragraph/anchored or inline picture/text box/body/header/footer/section/subsection), or a 4D Write Pro document (only its body element is used).

overloadMerges.semanticRole: Creates a new selection in the 4D Write Pro wpArea area, based upon targetObj or upon a startRange/endRange pair.
overloadMerges.note: star_operator_dual_signature (category C): both doc syntax lines are one overload where the leading '*' only toggles whether wpArea is a form-object name string or a variable/field reference; merged per the same convention as WA EXECUTE JAVASCRIPT FUNCTION / SET LIST ITEM PROPERTIES. targetObj and startRange/endRange remain the two alternative ways to define the selection (see jointConstraints).

jointConstraints.rule: targetObj and the startRange/endRange pair are alternative ways to specify the selection; pass one or the other, not both. startRange/endRange are only valid when the addressed element (targetObj, or the implicit area) is body/header/footer/section/subsection.

constraints: If no 4D Write Pro area is resolved from wpArea, the command does nothing.
wk start text may be passed in startRange and wk end text in endRange to mean the beginning/end of the area.
The command can only be used if wpArea is associated with a form object currently displayed in the form/page.
